title: Peruvian Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla, this Peruvian-inspired dish combines the flavors of the Andes with the comfort of melted cheese. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Fold the other half of the tortilla over the cheese and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining quesadillas and cheese.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with a side of quick fix.
Garnish with a sprinkle of ground cumin and paprika.
